to.description: Target run id, "root" for the root session, or @label for a registered top-level agent (requires can_message: mention)

wake.description: Omit for the default behaviour. false = deliver only: the message is never allowed to start a turn or resume a finished agent. true = wake the recipient (EXPENSIVE: starts a model turn; limited per sender and by a chain-depth ceiling — over the limit it is silently downgraded to deliver-only and the result says so). A running agent is always just steered. progress messages never wake (wake:true is rejected for them).
